This is our idea of the perfect raincoat: a single-breasted, fly-fronted piece which draws on, and works well with, both casual and more sartorial looks. It's generous in length and body, unlike a lot of modern raincoats, and the belt at the waist can be cinched to create shape. It is cut from a densely woven 10oz cotton spun in Como with a touch of metal, which repels water and wind, making it ideal for a stroll through the country, or equally for a blustery day around town. 96% Cotton, 4% Metal.
